title: Happy Sunday! The Blue Notebook Review Feb 1-8, 2026
description: A little rain didn’t slow us down. With more than 100 arrests again this week, SMPD remained proactive in the field. From traffic stops and DUI investigations to warrant and parole violations, officers stayed visible and focused on public safety.
transcript_text: Happy Sunday everybody. I hope you had an amazing week. My name is Sergeant Rick with the Sam Police Department and this is your blue notebook review. I'm going to keep my part short and sweet this week because the NROs are out there in the rain waiting to give you a little snippet as to what we accomplished last week to help lower crime and keep our streets safe. With that, let's start off with your B1 neighborhood resource officer, Officer Hollowell, to talk about crime. Hollowwell, what do you have for us? >> Thanks, Sergeant Rick. In this operational period, Santa Monica police officer responded to 2551 calls to service as well as conducted 107 arrests. I say again, 107 arrests. Great work. I'm going to tell you about two incidents that occurred this operational period. One being a check to welfare. Awatch patrol responded to a check to welfare and upon entering the location, they discovered two people were down. During the investigation, they discovered both persons sustained gunshot wounds. Criminal Investigations Division responded immediately to the location and determined that this was likely an apparent murder suicide. There are no outstanding threats to public safety and the investigation is ongoing. The next incident is of course our downtown services unit responded to multiple arrests. During two distracted driving operations, officers issued 24 citations, 19 for cell phone use. Your text can wait, but your bumper cannot.
